name: apiclaw
description: The API layer for AI agents. 26,000+ discoverable APIs, 1,650+ callable with zero config.
long_description: APIClaw is a unified gateway that gives your AI agent access to tens of thousands of APIs through one MCP server. 1,650+ are callable instantly with zero configuration. APIClaw holds the keys for managed providers like OpenRouter, Replicate, ElevenLabs, Brave Search, APILayer, GitHub, and the full APILayer suite. Universal pass-through for keyless public APIs. Includes capability-based routing, circuit breakers, SSRF protection, and full request logging. Built on Convex. Free tier with 25 API calls per month, email signup required.

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.description: Search 26,000+ APIs by capability. Returns ranked matches with pricing and metadata.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Execute any callable API through APIClaw. Auth handled automatically for managed providers.

tools.name: get_api_details
tools.description: Full specs, pricing, limits, and auth details for a specific API.

tools.name: list_connected
tools.description: List all managed providers ready for instant calls.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Browse APIs by category (AI, search, voice, communication, etc.).

tools.name: capability
tools.description: Route by capability (validate email, convert currency, transcribe audio). APIClaw picks the best provider.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate cost of a call before executing.

api_key.title: Workspace API Key (optional, see description)
api_key.description: APIClaw needs a workspace, not specifically this key. You have two ways to authenticate after signing up free at apiclaw.cloud/workspace: (1) paste your sk-claw-... key here, or (2) leave this blank and run 'apiclaw login' in a terminal to use session auth. Either works. Anonymous mode is closed, so calls without one of the two return 401.
